what: Ran ./setup.sh to adopt the landed auditor fix (build 9b32ec0 to 6e30f22). Before that, the operator ran athena audit with the stale binary, which recorded a hollow audit of 20261017-133559-1b3d (audit 20261017-200958-pg90, no files read, $0.28); the re-run with the fix read the files and recorded audit 20261017-201248-1ed1.
why: A landing that changes Athena's own code leaves the installed binary at the old build until setup runs again, so jobs and audits keep running old code with nothing to say so. The first audit should be read as void.
